title: Advisor consulted before a task is parked
item: Before the manager parks a task, it consults a read-only advisor agent on Fable at high effort, which may say the task can go on without the owner and how
motivation: Some parks may be avoidable: the manager parks on a doubt another strong model could settle from the repo. The owner's review should hold only what truly needs him.
notes: The advisor may not unpark: a fact only the owner knows, a failed protected-path check, a task verified by the owner (verified_by includes you, or runs_as is you), or anything on the never list. Those park whatever it says.
done_means: A manager-advisor agent exists with model Fable, effort high and read-only tools, linked in .claude/agents/ like the other two. commands/manage.md consults it before every park and parks anyway in the four cases above. SKILL.md says so. A test covers that the four cases always park.
draft_note: Drafted by Claude on 2026-11-15 at the owner's request. Priority left for the owner. Open choice: whether the four always-park cases are checked by a script or stay prose in manage.md; the test in done_means assumes a script.
